subtitle: Humanity and Philosophy

keywords: reading comprehension 2.understanding others 3.co-thinking 4.applicability to speciality 5.critical thinking
educationalGoal: To cultivate intelligence and originality, this course focuses on a philosophical work and aims to improve reading comprehension and ability to think by oneself. By discussing philosophical thoughts with others, it is expected for students to understand thoughts of others, think with others and develop an ability for critical thinking. Through these practices, it is expected for students to cultivate the thinking ability which is necessary for autonomous engineers.
advice: Course Description: In each class, students read philosophical text and conduct discussion. In the middle of the discussion, a lecturer gives lectures and answers questions from students. After the discussion, students make answers to the questions prepared on the report papers. After submitting group report, quizzes are carried out. A philosophical essay should be submitted at #10 . Students should choose theme of essay by themselves. Final report should be submitted after #14. Expectations for Students: ・ In this course, accurate understanding of text, development of original way of thinking and application to each student's research are expected. Be sure to work with these points in mind. ・ Recommend to look up unknown terms by yourself by an encyclopedia or a reference book spontaneously.
books: Discourse on the Method (Rene Descartes) (『方法序説』,デカルト,岩波書店,1997) 『デカルト「方法序説」を読む』,谷川多佳子,岩波書店,2014
requiredKnowledge: ・To have made a habit of reading and acquire reading comprehension. ・To have cultivated writing skills through "Basic Style for Study A and B".

activityGoals.body: To be able to understand philosophical thinking and explain them concretely.
To be able to express themselves about the relation between technology and philosophy.
To be able to understand and express the ideas of others about the relation between technology and philosophy.
To be able to express the process and results of thinking about the relation between technology and philosophy.
To be able to think critically about the technology and philosophy and explain them in clear sentences.
To be able to self-evaluate target abilities for students in this course.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Understanding philosophical thinking appropriately and explain them in your own words. 2. For technology and philosophy, expressing your thought process and its results in logical sentences. 3. Understanding other people's ideas about technology and philosophy and express them in logical sentences. 4.About technology and philosophy, expressing the process and the results of thinking with others in logical sentences. 5.Thinking critically about technology and philosophy and explaining them convincingly with clear sentences. 6.Being able to evaluate whether you understand the class constantly.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Understanding philosophical thinking and explain them concretely. 2. For technology and philosophy, expressing your thought process and its results in sentences. 3. Understanding other people's ideas about technology and philosophy and expressing them in sentences. 4. About technology and philosophy, expressing the process and the results of thinking with others in sentences. 5. Thinking critically about technology and philosophy and explaining them in sentences. 6.Being able to evaluate whether you understand the class to some degree.
